capabilities.label: Table-stakes core HRIS
capabilities.detail: — single system-of-record, profiles, org charts, document mgmt + e-sig, RBAC, configurable approval workflows, ESS/MSS (web + native mobile).

capabilities.label: Full-service payroll with automated tax as baseline
capabilities.detail: — auto federal/state/local calc/filing/remittance, multi-state, W-2/1099, direct deposit, garnishments, off-cycle; enterprise players (Workday, ADP, SAP, Rippling) differentiate on **global/multi-country payroll** (100–185+ countries).
features: off-cycle; enterprise players (Workday, ADP, SAP, Rippling) differentiate on **global/multi-country payroll** (100–185+ countries).

capabilities.label: Benefits administration converges
capabilities.detail: — open enrollment, medical/dental/vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k), life/disability, carrier EDI, ACA/COBRA, auto deduction sync; SMB vendors lean on partner marketplaces (Guideline, Human Interest), enterprise builds native.
features: auto deduction sync; SMB vendors lean on partner marketplaces (Guideline, Human Interest)

capabilities.label: Time/attendance/scheduling
capabilities.detail: universal (clock in/out, PTO/leave accruals, overtime, shift scheduling, auto-sync to payroll); geofencing/kiosk + labor forecasting are up-market differentiators.
features: universal (clock in/out, PTO/leave accruals, overtime, shift scheduling, auto-sync to payroll); geofencing/kiosk + labor forecasting are up-market differentiators.

capabilities.label: Full talent lifecycle now expected
capabilities.detail: — ATS → onboarding → performance/goals → comp → learning → succession/internal mobility. Enterprise suites offer all deeply; SMB tools lean on integrations.
features: — ATS → onboarding → performance/goals → comp → learning → succession/internal mobility. Enterprise suites offer all deeply; SMB tools lean on integrations.

capabilities.label: AI is the current battleground
capabilities.detail: — every vendor ships a conversational copilot (Illuminate, ADP Assist, Ask BambooHR, Gus, Joule) + AI for job descriptions/screening/matching/anomaly detection/turnover prediction. Workday/SAP/Rippling push into **autonomous agents**.
features: — every vendor ships a conversational copilot (Illuminate, ADP Assist, Ask BambooHR, Gus, Joule) + AI for job descriptions/screening/matching/anomaly detection/turnover prediction. Workday/SAP/Rippling push into **autonomous agents**.

capabilities.label: Skills-based talent intelligence
capabilities.detail: rising — Workday Skills Cloud, SAP Talent Intelligence Hub / Growth Portfolio / 30k-skill ontology, Opportunity Marketplace internal mobility reframe talent around inferred skills.
features: SAP Talent Intelligence Hub / Growth Portfolio / 30k-skill ontology
Opportunity Marketplace internal mobility reframe talent around inferred skills.

capabilities.label: Analytics/benchmarking
capabilities.detail: — from canned reports (SMB) to custom builders (Rippling, BambooHR) to industry benchmarking on massive datasets (ADP DataCloud 39M+ employees) + turnover/risk prediction.
features: — from canned reports (SMB) to custom builders (Rippling, BambooHR) to industry benchmarking on massive datasets (ADP DataCloud 39M+ employees) + turnover/risk prediction.

capabilities.label: Experience/engagement
capabilities.detail: now a named pillar — BambooHR community/wellbeing, SAP Qualtrics, Workday Employee Voice.
features: now a named pillar — BambooHR community/wellbeing

capabilities.label: Compliance/security as selling point
capabilities.detail: — multi-state/tax, ACA, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, encryption, audit trails universal; global vendors add 100+ country statutory localization.
features: audit trails universal; global vendors add 100+ country statutory localization.

capabilities.label: Differentiators
capabilities.detail: Rippling = unifies HR + IT (MDM/SSO/device inventory) + Finance (spend/cards/bills) on one Employee Graph · ADP = payroll-tax/compliance depth + PEO/outsourcing + DataCloud benchmarking · Workday = workforce planning (Adaptive) + Skills Cloud + Extend platform · SAP = deepest global localization/payroll + Talent Intelligence Hub + BTP · BambooHR = SMB all-in-one + employee experience/wellbeing · Gusto = SMB payroll-first + financial wellness (Wallet/on-demand pay). **PEO/EOR/global-employment** is a common adjacent play (Rippling, ADP, Gusto Global).
features: Rippling = unifies HR + IT (MDM/SSO/device inventory) + Finance (spend/cards/bills) on one Employee Graph · ADP = payroll-tax/compliance depth + PEO/outsourcing + DataCloud benchmarking · Workday = workforce planning (Adaptive) + Skills Cloud + Extend platform · SAP = deepest global localization/payroll + Talent Intelligence Hub + BTP · BambooHR = SMB all-in-one + employee experience/wellbeing · Gusto = SMB payroll-first + financial wellness (Wallet/on-demand pay). **PEO/EOR/global-employment** is a common adjacent play (Rippling, ADP, Gusto Global).
